title: Update Zephyr routing decisions for 02xx:: prefix
description: Update routing table lookups and forwarding decisions to route 02xx:: traffic correctly. Remove any ULA-specific routing logic. Files: lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/router.c, lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/include/lichen/routing/router.h. ~15 lines across 1-2 files. Depends on zt3c.7.4.
close_reason: Re-closing after store sync reverted the round-1 close (status came back open, no assignee, no close reason). Work unchanged and verified: routing decisions for 02xx:: were already 02xx-correct (classify exact 0x02 -> LICHEN_ADDR_YGGDRASIL, local-mesh-first, RPL upward fallback; no ULA logic in lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/); the only residue was the LICHEN_ROUTER_MAX_MESH_PREFIXES help text, fixed in commit 3193e837d2 ('fix(routing): drop ULA/GUA-era Kconfig help text'), verified 41/41 twister cases (routing_dispatch/gpsr/fwd_buffer, native_sim+qemu_x86) and 3x Kimi K3 codereview PASS. Discovered work previously filed: worker6-tiw2 (routing_announce retry regression).
